decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several speakers based on their output power and brand reliability. My consideration set included high-wattage budget options from Raymate, comiso, and NOTABRICK, as well as name-brand offerings from Altec Lansing and JBL. While the Raymate and comiso offer 30W of power at a low price point, I am skeptical of the long-term durability and sound quality of these generic manufacturers. The Altec Lansing HydraMotion, while a trusted brand, has reviews suggesting its volume is insufficient for outdoor environments. Finally, the JBL Flip 5 is a top performer, but the 'Renewed' condition combined with specific reports of battery death and charging failures after a few months makes it a risky purchase at $79.90. Lacking a brand-new, reliable option from a major brand, I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
